title: M\"obius Interaction Filtering: Order-Selective Spectral Regularization for Multimodal Humor Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.12913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal humor detection requires interpreting language, vocal delivery, and visual behavior jointly. Expressive fusion must also regulate how interactions of different orders enter the final judgment. We propose M\"obius Interaction Filtering (MoIF), which learns a modality-subset prediction function and imposes order-selective spectral regularization through its aggregation structure. Private temporal encoders and balanced reciprocal interaction construct supervised unimodal, bimodal, and trimodal predictors. Their uniform aggregate is exactly a M\"obius-domain filter with a geometrically decreasing interaction-order response. This formulation retains higher-order representations while regulating their contribution to prediction. Controlled UR-FUNNY perturbations reveal a pronounced decline in label-aligned signal-to-noise ratio across interaction orders. translated_title: 莫比乌斯交互过滤：面向多模态幽默检测的阶数选择性谱正则化
translated_abstract: 多模态幽默检测需要联合解读语言、声音表达和视觉行为，同时表达性融合还必须调控不同阶数的交互以何种程度进入最终判断。我们提出莫比乌斯交互过滤，它学习一个模态子集预测函数，并通过其聚合结构施加阶数选择性的谱正则化。私有时间编码器和平衡的双向交互构建了有监督的单模态、双模态和三模态预测器，它们的均匀聚合恰好构成一个具有几何递减交互阶响应的莫比乌斯域滤波器。这一构造在保留高阶表示的同时调控其对预测的贡献。在UR-FUNNY数据集上的受控扰动实验显示，各交互阶数的标签对齐信噪比出现显著下降。所诱导的滤波器使最终比率相对……提升了1.62-2.79倍。
tldr: 提出莫比乌斯交互过滤方法，通过阶数选择性谱正则化在保留高阶模态交互表示的同时调控其对预测的贡献，使多模态幽默检测的标签对齐信噪比提升1.62-2.79倍。
en_tdlr: Proposes Möbius Interaction Filtering, which uses order-selective spectral regularization to retain higher-order multimodal representations while regulating their contribution to prediction, improving the label-aligned signal-to-noise ratio by 1.62-2.79 times for humor detection.
